courses.summary: 賈姆訥格是整合煉油園區，原料、轉化、公用設施與出貨彼此耦合；本課用多產品帳研究整體最佳化。本課依序分析多產品收率閉合、跨單元熱回收、淨氫氣需求、原料與產品庫存、公用設施電力損失，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Jamnagar is an integrated refinery complex whose feeds, conversion, utilities and exports interact; the course uses multi-product balances. The course analyses multi-product yield closure, heat recovery across units, net hydrogen demand, feed and product inventory, utility-distribution electrical loss, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
